cases.sentence: От Павла, апостола Христа Иисуса, избранного по воле ___, возвещать обещанную им жизнь в Христе Иисусе.
cases.translation: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus.
cases.explain: The preposition по (by/according to) with the meaning of agency or reason requires the genitive case.
The dative case is used for the indirect object of the greeting; моему сыну (to my son).

cases.sentence: Я благодарю ___, которому служу с чистой совестью.
cases.translation: I thank God, whom I serve with a pure conscience.
cases.explain: The verb благодарю (I thank) is transitive and takes the direct object in the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Когда вспоминаю о тебе в своих молитвах, которые я совершаю день и ___,.
cases.translation: When I remember you in my prayers, which I make day and night.
cases.explain: In the time phrase день и ночь (day and night), both nouns take the accusative after день.

cases.sentence: Я вспоминаю и о твоей искренней ___ и искреней вере, которая была в твоей бабушке Лаиде.
cases.translation: I remember your sincere faith, which lived first in your grandmother Lois.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) requires the prepositional case: вспоминаю о вере.

cases.sentence: Раздуй пламя твоего дара, который ты получил от ___, через возложение моих рук.
cases.translation: Kindle the gift of God that is in you through the laying on of my hands.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) always requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Ведь Бог дал нам не дух страха, а дух силы, любви и ___.
cases.translation: For God did not give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
cases.explain: In the coordinate structure with дух (spirit), благоразумие takes the nominative/accusative, matching the other nouns in apposition.

cases.sentence: И теперь мы увидели эту благодать, когда пришел Спаситель наш Иисус Христос, который уничтожил смерть и через радостную весть показал новую жизнь и ___.
cases.translation: But has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.
cases.explain: In the coordinate structure жизнь и бессмертие after the verb показал (showed), both take the accusative.

reading.ru: От Павла, апостола Христа Иисуса, избранного по воле Бога, возвещать обещанную им жизнь в Христе Иисусе.
reading.question: Why was Paul chosen to be an apostle?
options: According to the will of God to proclaim the promise of life in Christ Jesus
Because of his personal merit and education
By the choice of the Jerusalem church
reading.correct: According to the will of God to proclaim the promise of life in Christ Jesus
reading.explain: Paul identifies himself as an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, appointed to proclaim the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus.

reading.ru: Я благодарю Бога, которому служу с чистой совестью, как это делали и мои праотцы.
reading.question: What does Paul say about his service to God?
options: He serves with a pure conscience, as his ancestors did
He has no family history of faith
reading.correct: He serves with a pure conscience, as his ancestors did
reading.explain: Paul states he thanks God, whom he serves with a pure conscience, as his forefathers also did.

reading.ru: Я вспоминаю твои слезы и очень хочу увидеть тебя.
reading.question: What does Paul want to do regarding Timothy?
options: He wants to see Timothy and is moved by remembering his tears
He wants to send him money
He plans to visit his family
reading.correct: He wants to see Timothy and is moved by remembering his tears
reading.explain: Paul explicitly says he remembers Timothy's tears and very much desires to see him, that he may be filled with joy.

reading.ru: Я вспоминаю и о твоей искренней вере.
reading.question: What quality of Timothy does Paul praise in this verse?
reading.explain: Paul says he remembers Timothy's sincere faith, which lived first in his grandmother Lois and mother Eunice.

reading.ru: Раздуй пламя твоего дара, который ты получил от Бога, через возложение моих рук.
reading.question: What does Paul encourage Timothy to do with his spiritual gift?
options: Kindle/stir up the gift of God that is in him through the laying on of hands
Share it only with mature believers
Question whether he truly has it
reading.correct: Kindle/stir up the gift of God that is in him through the laying on of hands
reading.explain: Paul reminds Timothy to stir up the gift of God which is in him through the laying on of Paul's hands.

reading.ru: Ведь Бог дал нам не дух страха, а дух силы, любви и благоразумия.
reading.question: What kind of spirit did God give according to this verse?
options: A spirit of power, love, and self-control, not fear
A spirit of fear and trembling
reading.correct: A spirit of power, love, and self-control, not fear
reading.explain: The verse states: Бог дал нам не дух страха, а дух силы, любви и благоразумия — God gave us not a spirit of fear but of power, love, and self-control.
